# langsmith_data_plane (Resource)

Manages an AWS LangSmith data plane in the current organization through the SaaS control-plane API. Requires BYOC enabled and organization administrator access. Creation also creates a workspace; deletion removes linked workspaces and deprovisions infrastructure. Consider `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`. Provisioning inputs require replacement. Create and update wait for `active`; delete waits for removal. Status is refreshed during Terraform reads, not continuously. The AWS role must trust the organization's assigned external ID and have deletion permissions for destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider with your SaaS control-plane endpoint and organization
# administrator credentials. The organization must have BYOC enabled, and the
# role must trust the organization's assigned external ID.
resource "langsmith_data_plane" "example" {
  name     = "production"
  region   = "us-east-1"
  role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/langsmith-byoc"
  vpc_cidr = "10.20.0.0/16"

  byoiam_enabled               = false
  public_load_balancer         = false
  eks_api_privatelink_disabled = false
  additional_tags              = { Environment = "production" }

  maintenance_window = "sun:03:00-sun:05:00"
  ttl = {
    enabled    = true
    short_days = 14
    long_days  = 400
  }
  firewall = {
    allowed_domains = [".aws.langchain-byoc.com", "api.example.com"]
    allow_http      = false
    allowed_cidrs   = { "10.0.0.0/8" = [443] }
  }
  fleet_oidc = {
    is_enabled      = false
    provider        = "custom"
    issuer_url      = "https://identity.example.com"
    audience        = "langsmith-fleet"
    subject_claim   = "sub"
    tenant_claim    = "tenant"
    tenant_mappings = {}
    email_claim     = "email"
    groups_claim    = "groups"
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "2h"
    update = "1h"
    delete = "2h"
  }

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Alternatively, replace vpc_cidr with a customer-managed VPC configuration:
# byovpc = {
#   vpc_id                 = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
#   public_subnet_ids      = ["subnet-11111111", "subnet-22222222"]
#   private_app_subnet_ids = ["subnet-33333333", "subnet-44444444"]
#   private_db_subnet_ids  = ["subnet-55555555", "subnet-66666666"]
# }

output "data_plane_status" {
  value = langsmith_data_plane.example.status
}

output "data_plane_api_url" {
  value = langsmith_data_plane.example.api_url
}

output "data_plane_workspaces" {
  value = langsmith_data_plane.example.workspaces
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique within the organization. Must not start with `internal`. Changing it replaces the data plane.
- `region` (String) AWS region supported by LangSmith. Changing it requires replacement.
- `role_arn` (String) Customer AWS IAM role used for provisioning. Changing it requires replacement.

### Optional

- `additional_tags` (Map of String) Additional AWS resource tags. At most 40; system-owned and AWS/controller-reserved keys are rejected by the API. Changing tags requires replacement.
- `byoiam_enabled` (Boolean) Use customer-managed IAM roles created by the LangSmith BYOIAM module. Defaults to false. Changing it requires replacement.
- `byovpc` (Attributes) Deploy into a customer-managed VPC instead of creating one. Subnet IDs must be distinct across tiers. Any change requires replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--byovpc))
- `eks_api_privatelink_disabled` (Boolean) Use a public EKS API endpoint restricted to LangSmith control-plane egress IPs instead of managed PrivateLink. Defaults to false. Changing it requires replacement.
- `firewall` (Attributes) Outbound network firewall settings. Omitted fields adopt server values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall))
- `fleet_oidc` (Attributes) Fleet external OIDC settings. Omitted fields adopt server values. Configure issuer, audience and required claims before enabling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fleet_oidc))
- `maintenance_window` (String) Two-hour weekly maintenance window in UTC, such as `sun:03:00-sun:05:00`. Omit to adopt the server value.
- `public_load_balancer` (Boolean) Use a public load balancer. Defaults to false. With BYOVPC, requires public subnets. Changing it requires replacement.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Maximum duration for each lifecycle operation, including polling. Durations use Go syntax such as `2h` or `30m`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `ttl` (Attributes) Blob retention settings. Omitted fields adopt server values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ttl))
- `vpc_cidr` (String) RFC1918 IPv4 network with a /16 to /18 prefix. Required when `byovpc` is omitted; must be omitted from configuration when `byovpc` is set. For BYOVPC, computed as the effective VPC CIDR. Changing it requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) Data plane API URL. The provider continues to manage this resource through the control plane.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider reported by the API, currently `AWS`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Data plane UUID. Import using this ID.
- `status` (String) Last observed lifecycle status: requested, provisioning, provisioning_failed, active, updating, inactive, deprovisioning, deleted, or revoked.
- `status_updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the last lifecycle status change.
- `workspaces` (Attributes Set) Associated workspaces, including the workspace automatically created with the data plane. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--byovpc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `byovpc`

Required:

- `private_app_subnet_ids` (Set of String) Two or three private application subnet IDs.
- `private_db_subnet_ids` (Set of String) Two or three private database subnet IDs.
- `vpc_id` (String) Customer-managed VPC ID.

Optional:

- `public_subnet_ids` (Set of String) Up to three public subnet IDs. Required for a public load balancer.


<a id="nestedatt--firewall"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall`

Optional:

- `allow_http` (Boolean) Allow HTTP in addition to HTTPS.
- `allowed_cidrs` (Map of Set of Number) Map of canonical IPv4 CIDRs (excluding /0) to sets of 1–20 TCP ports (1–65535). An empty map clears the rules.
- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Allowed domains; must include `.aws.langchain-byoc.com`. A leading dot matches subdomains.


<a id="nestedatt--fleet_oidc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fleet_oidc`

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Expected token audience.
- `email_claim` (String) Email claim name.
- `groups_claim` (String) Groups claim name.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Enable external OIDC authentication for Fleet.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `provider` (String) OIDC provider identifier.
- `subject_claim` (String) Subject claim name.
- `tenant_claim` (String) Tenant claim name.
- `tenant_mappings` (Map of String) Map external tenant claims to workspace UUIDs belonging to this data plane. An empty map clears the mappings.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Create timeout. Defaults to 2h.
- `delete` (String) Delete timeout. Defaults to 2h.
- `update` (String) Update timeout. Defaults to 1h.


<a id="nestedatt--ttl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ttl`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable retention.
- `long_days` (Number) Long retention period in days.
- `short_days` (Number) Short retention period in days; must not exceed long_days.


<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Workspace UUID.
- `name` (String) Workspace name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_data_plane.example aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa
```
